model.engine: scikit-learn trees and LogisticRegression, own rule extraction

rationale.en: Approval fiscal years FY1991 to FY2009: the 5-year mark of FY2009 closes on 2014-09-30, before the first approval of FY2015-17 on 2014-10-01. 900,254 loans with a known 5-year outcome and 110,349 charge-offs; the rungs were fitted on a stratified sample of 40,000 of them. The window holds 23,163 charge-offs dated in the recession (December 2007 to June 2009): the model is trained through the crisis.
rationale.es: Años fiscales de aprobación AF1991 a AF2009: la marca de 5 años de AF2009 cierra el 2014-09-30, antes de la primera aprobación de AF2015-17 el 2014-10-01. 900.254 créditos con resultado a 5 años conocido y 110.349 castigos; los peldaños se ajustaron con una muestra estratificada de 40.000 de ellos. La ventana contiene 23.163 castigos fechados en la recesión (diciembre de 2007 a junio de 2009): el modelo se entrena a través de la crisis.

definition.en: A loan is an event when the file shows it charged off within 60 months of approval, on or before the observation date. The target of a vintage is read only at its 5-year mark (30 September of the fiscal year plus 5). A loan observed for the whole 60 months without a charge-off, paid in full, charged off later or still active, is a non-event: the file shows a charge-off as CHGOFF, never as an active loan. A loan observed for less than 60 months and not charged off (EXEMPT, active) is right-censored: it has no outcome, is counted apart and is never counted as performing.
definition.es: Un crédito es evento cuando el archivo lo muestra castigado dentro de los 60 meses desde la aprobación, hasta la fecha de observación. El objetivo de una cosecha se lee solo en su marca de 5 años (30 de septiembre del año fiscal más 5). Un crédito observado los 60 meses completos sin castigo, pagado, castigado después o aún vigente, es un no evento: el archivo muestra un castigo como CHGOFF, nunca como crédito vigente. Un crédito observado menos de 60 meses y sin castigo (EXEMPT, vigente) es censurado por la derecha: no tiene resultado, se cuenta aparte y nunca se cuenta como vigente sano.

notice.en: The SBA 7(a) loans are loans to small businesses made by lenders under a federal guarantee program, not the SME book of a bank: the file has no delinquency history, no balance and no rating, and the sample is not a bank's portfolio. The interest rate is recorded only from the FY2008 approvals and is not a model input.
notice.es: Los créditos SBA 7(a) son créditos a pequeñas empresas otorgados por prestamistas bajo un programa federal de garantía, no la cartera pyme de un banco: el archivo no tiene historia de mora, saldo ni calificación, y la muestra no es la cartera de un banco. La tasa de interés se registra solo desde las aprobaciones del año fiscal 2008 y no es una entrada del modelo.

scope.en: vintages with an observed 5-year mark: FY2015 to FY2017
scope.es: cosechas con marca de 5 años observada: AF2015 a AF2017

rung_comparison.reason: TabPFN is the optional extra (data-pipeline/requirements-tabpfn.txt) and it is not installed in the bake environment: the challenger is declared absent, and no number stands in for it

psi_note.en: PSI of the champion's PD distribution in each vintage against the training rows (ten bins on the training quantiles); 0.10 and 0.25 are conventions, not limits. The observed 5-year PD against the training mean is the crisis contrast.
psi_note.es: PSI de la distribución de PD del campeón en cada cosecha contra las filas de entrenamiento (diez tramos sobre los cuantiles de entrenamiento); 0,10 y 0,25 son convenciones, no límites. La PD observada a 5 años contra la media de entrenamiento es el contraste de la crisis.

tests.reference: ECB (2019), Instructions for reporting the validation results of internal models: IRB Pillar I models for credit risk, section 2.5.3.1; Brown, Cai and DasGupta (2001), doi:10.1214/ss/1009213286

tests.h0: the true PD is less than or equal to the PD applied, defaults independent
tests.alternative: the true PD exceeds the PD applied
tests.reference: BCBS (2005), Studies on the validation of internal rating systems, Working Paper 14 (revised), section on calibration (binomial test; an early warning when defaults are correlated)
tests.notes: assumes independent defaults; WP14: the true type I error can be much larger if defaults are correlated

tests.h0: the true PD is less than or equal to the PD applied, defaults correlated through one systematic factor
tests.alternative: the true PD exceeds the PD applied
tests.reference: BCBS (2005), Studies on the validation of internal rating systems, Working Paper 14 (revised), appendix (one-factor model with asset correlation)
tests.notes: asset correlation 0.12 is a modelling assumption

tests.h0: the predicted probabilities equal the true default probabilities in every risk group
tests.alternative: the predicted probabilities are miscalibrated in at least one group

tests.h0: every obligor's predicted PD equals its true default probability
tests.alternative: the forecasts are miscalibrated
